You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem\-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. In this role, you’ll balance hands\-on delivery with long\-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

  

What you will do

* Automate workflows, operational processes, and deployment activities to improve efficiency, reliability, consistency, and scalability.

Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging technologies while pursuing certifications and advancing toward senior technical leadership roles.  
* 

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with other  



  

Required skills and experience
  

  

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  

Preferred skills and experience  

  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: MIS Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

MIS Executive
  
Account Management – Work Dynamics (Country, Region)
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

**Job Overview:**  

We are seeking a skilled and proactive MIS Executive to join our Facility Management team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining information systems that support and enhance our facility management operations. This role requires a unique blend of IT expertise and understanding of facility management processes to ensure seamless integration of technology in our day\-to\-day operations, data\-driven decision making, and improved operational efficiency.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Develop and implement MIS strategies aligned with facility management goals and objectives. Oversee the selection, implementation, and maintenance of facility management information systems, including CAFM (Computer\-Aided Facility Management) and CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software. Ensure the integrity, security, and reliability of facility\-related data and information systems. Collaborate with facility managers and other stakeholders to identify information needs and develop appropriate solutions. Design and implement dashboards and reporting tools to provide real\-time insights into facility performance metrics. Manage the integration of various facility management systems, including BMS (Building Management Systems), access control, and energy management systems. Develop and maintain databases for asset management, maintenance schedules, and space utilization. Provide training and support to facility management staff on the use of MIS tools and systems. Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement in facility management operations. Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and company policies regarding information security. Coordinate with IT department to ensure alignment of facility management systems with overall IT infrastructure. Manage vendor relationships for facility management software and related IT services. Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends in facility management IT solutions. Develop and manage the budget for facility management IT projects and systems. Provide regular reports to senior management on the performance and impact of facility management information systems.
  
  

**Qualifications:**  

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field. An additional degree or certification in Facility Management is a plus. 5\+ years of experience in IT roles, with at least 3 years of experience in facility management or related field. Strong knowledge of facility management software, including CAFM and CMMS systems. Experience with database management, data analysis, and reporting tools. Familiarity with BMS, IoT technologies, and their application in smart buildings. Understanding of facility management processes and best practices. Experience in project management, particularly in IT implementation projects. Knowledge of data security and protection regulations.

title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.


**C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.**


C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

title: Director Guest Service Center

This role requires a balance of operational leadership, strategic thinking, innovation and enterprise influence. differentiated and connected guest experiences.

experiences, tools and processes that improve guest outcomes.

Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources and other enterprise functions.

* Drive shared accountability for enterprise guest outcomes across organizational


boundaries.  

* Represent Service Center perspectives during strategic business initiatives and


transformation efforts.**Transformation \& Change Leadership**

* Design and implement future\-ready operating models that incorporate automation, AI and evolving customer expectations.

environments.  

* Experience redesigning workflows and operating models using automation or GenAI capabilities.

partnerships. **Working at Target**  

We are committed to creating meaningful experiences for our guests and team members. As a Director, Service Center, you will have the opportunity to shape strategy, influence enterprise outcomes, develop future leaders, and make a significant impact on the success of Target's business and culture.

title: Senior Architect (Data, Cloud, AI)
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

Ellucian is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next\-generation Data Platform and analytics solution. This role will be instrumental in transforming our current data warehouse ecosystem into a modern, scalable, cloud\-native Lakehouse platform capable of supporting analytics, AI/ML workloads, agentic AI experiences, and real\-time data products.


This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in data platforms, data warehouse, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and emerging AI technologies.


As a key technical leader , role offers opportunities to spearhead technical initiatives, mentor engineers at all levels, and work closely with internal product managers, experienced engineers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver advanced features that enhance student success and drive higher education transformation.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Build and own the target\-state architecture for a next\-generation Lakehouse platform.
* Develop technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and product vision.
* Lead architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, observability, security, and AI enablement.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures.

**Platform Modernization**

* Lead migration from traditional data warehouse architectures to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Design scalable data platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Evaluate and drive adoption of technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, DuckDB, Trino, Flink, Kafka, and cloud\-native analytics services.
* Design multi\-tenant SaaS architectures with strong security and data isolation.

**AI \& Intelligent Data Platform**

* Define architecture patterns enabling AI\-powered data experiences.
* Design platforms supporting:
* + Generative AI applications
	+ Agentic AI workflows
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector databases and semantic search
	+ AI\-assisted analytics and insights
* Partner with AI teams to operationalize ML and GenAI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine applicability to the platform roadmap.

**Technical Leadership**

* Take ownership of critical tasks from specification review through final testing and deployment, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as the highest level technical authority for the platform.
* Mentor architects and senior engineers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and guide critical design decisions.
* Drive engineering excellence and technical innovation across teams.

**Scalability, Reliability \& Operations**

* Architect for high availability, performance, resiliency, and cost optimization.
* Define observability and operational excellence standards.
* Drive platform reliability through automation and SRE practices.
* Establish governance around performance, security, compliance, and data quality.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: Bachelor / Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or related field. Overall 15\+ years of software engineering exp with 7\+ years of professional software development experience in a product or SaaS environment building modern Data platform.
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures including Data warehouse, Data Mesh, Data platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed data processing frameworks, Apache Spark, Trino, Flink, Kafka.
* Experience with open table formats, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.

  

* Strong understanding of Metadata management, Lineage, observability.
* **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing, building, and evolving large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and highly available production services.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering**: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, containerization, infrastructure automation, and modern operational practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* **Engineering Excellence**: Deep experience with CI/CD, code review, test automation, observability, release engineering, and DevOps practices in modern software delivery environments.
* **Security and Risk Awareness**: Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure design, and practical application security principles in enterprise software.

title: Manager of Learning and Development
description:
**Job Title**

Manager of Learning and Development
**Job Description**

**So, who are we?**

  

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.


The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here *.*

**Your team**

You will sit within the global customer experience team and have a SEO manager to support on day\-to\-day execution and two Content Editors who produce and optimise the editorial output across ig.com.


**Your role in the Team’s Success**

The Manager of Training \& Knowledge Management will lead IG Group’s strategy for customer support learning, product knowledge, and knowledge management within the Trading Services function. This role combines leadership, strategic vision, and digital innovation. You will oversee the design and delivery of training programs (using platforms such as Sana or other AI\-enabled learning solutions), manage our knowledge systems, and ensure that our teams across the globe have the skills and resources to provide exceptional customer experiences.


**What you’ll do**

**Learning \& Training Strategy**

* Define and implement a global learning strategy that equips customer support teams with skills in product knowledge, customer service, compliance, and digital tools.
* Leverage AI\-powered learning platforms to create scalable, adaptive, and personalised learning solutions.
* Embed continuous learning into onboarding, career pathways, and product adoption initiatives.

**Knowledge Management**

* Develop and own Trading Services knowledge management strategy, ensuring critical product and process knowledge is structured, accessible, and always up\-to\-date.
* Integrate knowledge bases, AI chatbots, and digital tools to support just\-in\-time learning and problem solving.

**Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of learning designers, trainers, and knowledge managers.
* Partner with senior leaders across Product, Compliance, and Trading and Operations to align learning and knowledge initiatives to business priorities.
* Act as a thought leader for innovative training practices, championing digital transformation in learning.

**Measurement \& Impact**

* Define KPIs for learning and knowledge initiatives, using analytics and AI insights to demonstrate business impact.
* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating learner feedback, data, and performance outcomes into strategy.

**What you’ll need for this role**

**Key Qualification Requirements:**

* Proven senior experience in learning \& development, training, or knowledge management leadership roles.
* Strong track record in designing and implementing corporate learning strategies.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning and knowledge management platforms (Sana, Docebo, Cornerstone, ServiceNow KM, or similar).
* Demonstrated success in leading teams and managing global stakeholders.
* Excellent business acumen and ability to align learning strategy with operational and commercial goals.

**Bonus if you have:**

* Background in financial services, fintech, or trading environments.
* Experience driving digital transformation in customer service organisations.
* Familiarity with regulatory training requirements in financial markets.

**How we work**

We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office – which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other . When it comes to how we deliver, there are 5 things we want everyone to do to drive high performance, better learning and career satisfaction:


* **Lead and Inspire:** Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* **Think Big:** Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* **Champion the client:** Understand and prioritise client's needs
* **Deliver at pace:** Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* **Raise the bar:** Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback

We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We’re committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey.


**The Perks**

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.  



**Join us for this exciting journey.** **Apply now!**

**Preferred Requirements**

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and empathetic Relationship Manager to join our Relationship Marketing team at KoinBX. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our users throughout their lifecycle — from their very first sign\-up and KYC verification to becoming confident, active traders on the platform.

You will own the end\-to\-end user onboarding experience, conduct user interviews to uncover pain points and feature needs, and serve as the voice of the customer to internal product and leadership teams. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a genuine curiosity about user behaviour and a passion for crypto and Web3\.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding \& User Support

* Guide new users through the complete onboarding journey — account creation, KYC verification, first deposit, and first trade — ensuring a smooth, friction\-free experience.
* Proactively identify and resolve onboarding drop\-offs by reaching out to stalled users via calls, emails, or in\-app messages.
* Maintain a structured onboarding playbook and continuously update it based on user feedback and product changes.
* Track and report onboarding completion rates, time\-to\-first\-trade, and other funnel metrics weekly.

User Research \& Interviews

* Plan, schedule, and conduct structured user interviews (1\-on\-1 calls, surveys, feedback sessions) to deeply understand user pain points, motivations, and trading behaviour.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative user insights into actionable reports for the Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
* Build and maintain a user research repository — tagging insights by theme (e.g., UX friction, feature requests, trust concerns, pricing feedback).
* Recruit and manage a panel of power users and early adopters for ongoing beta testing and feedback loops.

Relationship Marketing \& Retention

* Design and execute lifecycle campaigns (welcome sequences, re\-engagement, milestone celebrations) in coordination with the Marketing team.
* Segment the user base by activity level, trading volume, and engagement score to personalise outreach and retention strategies.
* Own NPS, CSAT, and user health score tracking; flag at\-risk cohorts and implement targeted win\-back initiatives.
* Drive referral program adoption and community engagement by nurturing relationships with high\-value and high\-influence users.

Internal Communication \& Advocacy

* Act as the "Voice of the Customer" — regularly present user insights, recurring complaints, and feature requests to the Product Manager, Design Lead, and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with the Customer Support team to escalate systemic issues and close the loop on user\-reported bugs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly user sentiment reports with clear, data\-backed recommendations for cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing on user testimonials, case studies, and community content by identifying and nurturing brand advocates.

Required Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Relationship Management, Customer Success, Account Management, or User Research — preferably in a fintech, crypto, or high\-growth product company.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting user interviews, surveys, and qualitative research.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi is must and other regional languages is a plus.
* Empathetic, patient, and user\-first mindset — you genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems.
* Analytical thinking: comfort with data, funnels, and metrics (onboarding rates, NPS, CSAT, retention cohorts).
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment with minimal hand\-holding.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or Web3 industry.
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Freshdesk, Intercom, or similar) and engagement platforms (CleverTap, MoEngage, or similar).
* Background in UX research methodologies (jobs\-to\-be\-done, usability testing, journey mapping).
* Experience with lifecycle marketing tools and campaign design.
* Familiarity with Indian regulatory context for crypto — KYC/AML flows, FIU\-IND compliance, VDA taxation basics.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* Empathy \& Active Listening — Ability to make users feel heard and translate emotions into structured insights.
* Ownership \& Accountability — Takes full ownership of user outcomes from first touch to resolution.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration — Works seamlessly with Product, Design, Engineering, Support, and Marketing.
* Data\-Informed Storytelling — Turns raw feedback and numbers into compelling narratives that drive action.
* Adaptability — Comfortable navigating shifting priorities in a fast\-moving crypto startup.
* Problem Solving — Identifies root causes rather than surface symptoms; proposes solutions, not just escalations.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Front\-row seat in one of India's fastest\-growing crypto exchanges.
* Direct impact on user experience and product roadmap — your insights shape what we build.
* A collaborative, transparent, and low\-ego team culture.

Pay: From ₹18,000\.00 per month

Language:

* Hindi (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Software Technical Leader
description:

Reporting into the BSW engineering leadership, the role combines deep hands\-on expertise with mentoring and cross global collaboration, allowing the leader to impact multiple programs and platforms. * Performing AutoSAR System configuration (SWC compositions like Component instances, connectors), optimize AUTOSAR based SW architecture in multicore environment.

* Must have BSW software development experience in configuration of BSW components, Bootloader stack, Communication Stack, Diagnostic stack, Memory stack, Network management including CAN, LIN, Flexray, Ethernet, and UDS protocols, Memory Stack, OS, ECUM, BSWM, WDG, NVM etc, Instrumentation development using XCP, XETK, UDS
* Solid Hands\-on experience in Vector DaVinci tool chain, EBTresos and ETAS ISOLAR
* Must have experienced with 32bit Infineon TC 3xx microcontroller
* Exemplary expertise in Embedded SW development using C language, debugging for embedded multithreaded and multi core/CPU software environment.
* Strong ability to comprehend microcontroller hardware and associated schematics
* Experience in configuration \& Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, BitBucket, Gitlab, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/VectorCAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/NeoVI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking.

* Self\-motivated with a strong and flexible attitude towards work

* Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly on technical issues.

Job Description:
**Job Description for Sr Hardware Program Manager**

**Title: \- Senior Specialist, Project Management (JPPP4\)****Summary:**
As a Senior Specialist, Project Management, you lead cross\-functional efforts supporting the lifecycle, manufacturability, and delivery of hardware products. You serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Management, and external OEM partners to ensure products remain available, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. You oversee hardware lifecycle initiatives, monitor component availability risks, manage product change activities, and drive execution of hardware projects from concept through deployment and sustainment.
Your mission is to proactively identify and mitigate product availability risks, coordinate hardware lifecycle activities, and ensure successful execution of hardware programs without disrupting customer commitments. Your impact is measured through successful product delivery, reduced supply chain risk, effective OEM management, and timely execution of hardware refresh and sustainment initiatives.* Owns the intersection between:
	+ Hardware Engineering
	+ Manufacturing
	+ Supply Chain
	+ OEM partners
	+ Product Management
* Their primary mission is to ensure:
	+ Products remain buildable
	+ Risks are identified early
	+ Component lifecycle issues are visible
	+ Hardware refresh projects move forward
	+ Supply chain actions are completed
	+ OEM partners meet commitments

**Responsibilities:*** **Hardware Program Management**
	+ Lead hardware lifecycle and sustainment projects across the NetBotz product portfolio.
	+ Develop and maintain project plans for hardware refreshes, component replacement activities, product updates, and new hardware introductions.
	+ Track risks, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables across multiple concurrent hardware programs.
	+ Coordinate activities between Engineering, Manufacturing, and Product Management
* **Component Lifecycle \& Supply Chain Coordination**
	+ Monitor component lifecycle status, end\-of\-life notifications, supplier advisories, lead times, and supply chain risks.
	+ Ensure identified component risks have documented mitigation plans and clear ownership.
	+ Track execution of last\-time\-buy (LTB) activities and related supply chain actions.
	+ Work with Supply Chain and Engineering teams to understand demand forecasts and potential supply constraints.
	+ Maintain visibility into critical component availability and associated business risks.
* **Product Change Management**
	+ Coordinate Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and related product change activities.
	+ Track progress of hardware change projects from identification through implementation and release.
	+ Ensure stakeholders understand the schedule, impact, and status of product changes.
	+ Facilitate communication between engineering teams and manufacturing partners regarding product updates.
* **Risk Management \& Reporting**
	+ Regularly communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders and leadership.
	+ Identify emerging risks and drive corrective actions before they impact customers or production schedules.
	+ Monitor partner commitments, deliverables, and action items.
	+ Escalate issues proactively to prevent disruptions to manufacturing and product availability.
* Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support project or departmental objectives.

* Understanding of component lifecycle management, end\-of\-life (EOL) processes, and supply chain risk management.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) and other product change processes.

title: Sr. Solution Consultant III
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.



What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.



Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.



Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together!


We are looking for a self\-motivated **Sr.** **SOLUTION CONSULTANT** to join our Asia Presales team, to support our Philippines business\- An excellent opportunity for candidates who are looking for regional exposure and willing to relocate to Philippines.



A position with Anaplan's presales team means being part of one of the fastest growing cloud vendors and making your mark on a changing industry. You get to meld your love of numbers with your love of sales and be rewarded for success with an outstanding commission structure in a fast moving, stimulating environment. As a Solution Consultant, you enjoy helping people solve hard problems. You are a bit savvy about cool products and you love showing people how those products can help their businesses.  

You will join a team of individuals who embrace and respect diverse perspectives, aren't afraid to push boundaries and try new insights, and are passionate about helping our customers and each other succeed. We work hard, but we also don't wait for an excuse to have fun. In fact, we're so serious about it that it's one of our core values.


**What you will be doing:**


* Engaging with targeted, large enterprise prospects to identify broken business processes and problems. Ascertaining and explaining Anaplan's outstanding ability to solve them.
* Developing planning function\-specific solutions, demos, and messaging. Building Proof of Concept models that are tailored to solve prospects' problems.
* Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to facilitate the adoption of the Anaplan solution.
* Cross\-training teammates on solution expertise.
* Creating product awareness in the marketplace.


**More about you:**


* BS / BA / Finance or equivalent. (Post Grad and Professional Qualifications a plus)
* A background in financial planning / planning, budgeting \& forecasting / financial operation planning / financial analysis
* Experience with multi\-dimensional modelling, business intelligence, or analytics
* Prior experience in Enterprise Planning Management a plus
* Aptitude for quickly ramping up on new technology
* Excellent presentation, client relationship, and interpersonal skills\- both internally and externally


**Preferred skills and technical familiarity:**


* Growth mentality
* You're comfortable challenging old ways of doing things
* Ability to take a consultative selling approach by listening to customer needs and shaping a shared vision for a solution
* 8\+ years of presales/consulting/implementing or like experience

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!



We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**



It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.



Anaplan does not:


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.


All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.



Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in telecommunications working with network infrastructure, transmission systems, layer2/3 routers and data services.
* 2 years of experience in IP networking, and key networking protocols like TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, ISIS, SDN etc.
* Experience in network operations, systematic troubleshooting in IP and optical environment.
* Ability to work non\-standard hours, including working nights, weekends, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Certifications in Network (CCNA/CCNP/CCIE/CCDE/JNCIE/JNCIP) or equivalent practice experience.
* Experience in a network operations center or technical assistance center environment managing IP and optical networks.
* Understanding of generic protocols and their applications, device repair, network topologies and global internet technologies.
* Ability to use, understand and navigate Element Management System (EMS) and Network Management System (NMS) systems to manage optical networks.
* Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to work non\-standard hours, including working nights, weekends, holidays and on shift\-based schedules as required in a network operations center environment.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.


You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost\-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.



Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.  

  



**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a first responder for faults and outages on Google's production network. Monitor network health and identify potential risks or performance degradation. Participate in an on\-call rotation to provide 24/7 network support.
* Perform root cause analysis on network incidents and implement corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.
* Identify opportunities for and contribute to the development of automation and tooling to improve repair times and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to manage and resolve network issues.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Principal Engineer - Email Engineering
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer to join the Email Engineering team within Workplace Technology (WT). This role serves as the technical authority and principal engineer responsible for the modernization, architecture, and engineering leadership of the firm’s enterprise messaging platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft Exchange, Exchange Online, and Microsoft 365 services. Workplace Technology, part of Enterprise Functions Technology (EFT), delivers critical enterprise capabilities across Endpoint \& Mobility, Enterprise Messaging \& Collaboration, Voice \& Telephony, Security, and Specialized Desktop Services. Within WT, the Email Engineering team plays a vital role in enabling secure, reliable, resilient, and compliant electronic communications at enterprise scale. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural vision, and the ability to operate and influence at scale across a large, regulated enterprise.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long\-term, large\-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in\-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* As a Principal Engineer, you will serve as technical authority in shaping the future‑state enterprise messaging architecture, driving cloud and hybrid strategies, strengthening the organization’s security and compliance posture, and ensuring resilient, highly available service delivery across the Hybrid Exchange ecosystem.
* Serve as the Principal Engineer and technical authority for enterprise email and messaging platforms.
* Design, deploy, and operate Microsoft Exchange Online, Exchange Server, and Hybrid Exchange architectures.
* Engineer, operate, and optimize the enterprise SMTP backbone and secure email platforms, including:
	+ Proofpoint MTAs (mandatory, hands\-on ownership)
	+ Zix Secure Email
	+ Sendmail and Postfix
* Design and support SMTP architecture, mail routing, and policy enforcement using DNS, LDAP, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Apply advanced networking and high availability principles to support secure, load\-balanced email traffic across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of email platforms, including onboarding, upgrades, patching, capacity planning, performance tuning, decommissioning, and roadmap alignment.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, resiliency, and performance for a global user base.
* Partner closely with Information Security to support:
	+ Vulnerability management and remediation
	+ Security patching and audits
	+ Proactive risk identification and mitigation
* Drive audit readiness and ensure compliance with enterprise security and regulatory standards.
* Define and enforce engineering standards across:
	+ Monitoring and telemetry
	+ Patch and vulnerability management
	+ Change and release governance
* Champion automation first approaches using PowerShell, scripting, and Graph API to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Own platform reliability, availability, and performance metrics.
* Act as Level 4 escalation for complex, cross\-platform incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventative, systemic improvements.
* Manage changes in alignment with ITIL\-aligned change management practices.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to senior and principal\-level engineers.
* Serve as a force multiplier across multiple engineering teams and lines of business.
* Review and influence architecture and designs for high\-impact initiatives beyond direct ownership.
* Collaborate closely with Architecture, Product Management, User Experience, Information Security, Resiliency, and Infrastructure teams.
* Partner with Product Managers to align engineering execution with L2/L3 OKRs and business outcomes.
* Engage with vendors and manufacturers for platform support, upgrades, implementations, and roadmap planning.
* Develop and lead technical forums, working groups, and communities of practice to drive engineering excellence and architectural consistency.

**Job Expectations:**

* 7\+ years of experience in enterprise email and messaging engineering.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise with Microsoft Exchange (Hybrid architectures).
* Mandatory hands\-on experience with Proofpoint MTAs.
* Strong experience with secure email platforms (Zix preferred).
* Deep understanding of:
	+ SMTP, DNS, LDAP, SPF, DKIM, DMARC
* Experience with Sendmail, Postfix, Milters, OpenLDAP, Proofpoint MTAs, Zix Gateways.
* Strong networking fundamentals:
	+ IPv4 / IPv6
	+ TCP / UDP
	+ NAT, PAT, ACLs, VLANs
* Proven experience in platform lifecycle management:
	+ Upgrades
	+ Patching
	+ Capacity planning
	+ Decommissioning

* Demonstrated experience providing Level 4 production support.

* Excellent communication skills, capable of influencing technical and executive audiences.

title: Manager, Customer Care
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


\<p\>Join PayPal’s Global Partner Management team within Service Experience, overseeing outsourced partners in India that support customer service for PayPal, Venmo and Xoom across global markets. You will drive partner governance, operational performance, service quality and financial accountability across the outsourced network. The role connects partner sites with teams including Workforce Management, Training, Compliance and Risk, using operational and customer insights to strengthen service delivery, address performance gaps and ensure partners consistently meet PayPal standards.\</p\>

**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
* Implement a multi\-phased strategy to enhance the overall customer experience.
  

  
* Identify customer pain points and develop data\-driven improvement strategies.
  

  
* Lead cross\-functional teams to prioritize and execute customer\-focused initiatives.

* Create and present business cases, projects, and analyses in a clear and compelling manner.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

  

  
* 5\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

* 5\+ years of experience in vendor or partner management, contact\-center operations, or operational excellence, with demonstrated success driving measurable performance improvements in an outsourced operating model.
* Proven experience managing BPO or outsourced customer\-service providers and establishing effective partner\-governance practices.
* Strong knowledge of contact\-center operations and KPIs such as AHT, FCR, CSAT and NPS.
* Experience with workforce planning, operational cost management and partner capacity or location planning.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including translating complex operational data into clear recommendations and actions.
* Experience with structured root\-cause analysis and continuous\-improvement methodologies.
* Process and project management experience; familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent operational frameworks is preferred.
* FinTech or financial\-services experience is preferred.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including communicating operational insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate effectively across global, cross\-functional teams and outsourced partner environments.

title: Integration Project Administrator
description:
**Overview**  

**Purpose:**  

  

The Platform Operations, Support, and Onboarding teams ensure the reliability, stability, and seamless functioning of CitrusAd's production systems and offerings, operating as a centre of excellence for service delivery across the integration lifecycle.
  

  

The Integration Project Administrator, based in Epsilon India, provides administrative and coordination support to Integration Project Managers across the APJ, EMEA, and AMER portfolios. The role keeps integration projects on track, ensures administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time, and contributes to the standardisation of integration delivery globally. The position extends 24/5 coverage of integration delivery by adding an India working\-day footprint to the existing AU, US and UK presence.
  

**Core Objectives**  

* Project Coordination
* Operational Practices
* Stakeholder Engagement
* System Reliability
* Product Knowledge
* Team Membership
* Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification
* Personal Capability Building

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Project Coordination**
  

* Assist in planning, organising, and coordinating integration projects, including scheduling meetings, updating project tasks, maintaining project calendars, and ensuring goals and deadlines are met.
* Create, organise, and maintain project documentation, including project plans, scope documents, reports, and meeting minutes in ServiceNow and SharePoint.
* Track resource availability and utilisation across project team members; flag conflicts to the Director and Integration Project Managers.
* Serve as a central point of contact for project\-related communication across India, AU, UK, and US time zones; distribute information, schedule cross\-region meetings, and keep partners informed.
* Prepare and present reports on project progress, RAID logs, and onboarding Retun on Investment data.
* Assist Integration Project Managers in managing budget, scope, and delivery.
* Identify project risks and impacts to timelines; coordinate mitigation activities with the Integration Project Manager.
* Support the service transition into Platform Operations for technical support of clients post\-launch.
* Uphold processes and procedures for the best change management across production platforms.

  

**Operational Practices**
  

* Uphold operational practices for software implementation and project management.
* Support proactive incident and problem detection during integration and hypercare phases.
* Support the operational integrity of all production environments.
* Work as a team to ensure SLAs and practices are well defined, documented, and consistently applied.
* Uphold the IT Service and Support workflow, with a particular focus on best\-in\-class customer experience.

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Client Integration Engineering, Product, Release Management, Platform Operations, and Global Support.
* Maintain strong relationships with retailers and partners, ensuring their needs are met while protecting the business needs of CitrusAd and Epsilon.
* Act as a regional point of contact for India\-based retailers and India\-based engineering and account teams.

  

**System Reliability**
  

* Work with Engineering, Product, Delivery, and Security teams to ensure appropriate attention is given to production and system reliability for customers.
* Uphold operational practices in conjunction with Product and Engineering teams, including understanding how integrations and configurations may affect reliability, performance, and cost.

  

**Product Knowledge**
  

* Keep up to date with Epsilon Retail Media product suite features, improvements, and roadmap.
* Stay abreast of industry trends in retail media, ad\-tech, and advertising in India and globally.
* Understand the different facets of the CitrusAd system, including Reporting, Ad Serving, API Integration, Product Catalog, and Ad Placements.
* Maintain a solid level of knowledge of the technical integration and functionality of Epsilon and CitrusAd Onsite and Offsite core platforms, supporting products, toolsets, and partner systems.

  

**Team Membership**
  

* Act in the best interest of the Customer and the Team at all times.
* Drive cohesion between team members across India, AU, UK, and US; build strong relationships across the Platform Operations and Support group.
* Collaborate with internal delivery teams to ensure a high\-quality customer experience for case resolution and support.

  

**Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification**
  

* Ensure all processes and procedures are documented for continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement process improvement and simplification with leadership and partner teams.
* Proactively identify new opportunities to improve and simplify integration delivery, tooling, and governance.

  

**Personal Capability Building**
  

* Develop own capabilities through assessment, development planning, and formal and informal training and coaching.
* Gain or maintain external professional accreditation where relevant.
* Maintain an in\-depth understanding of project management methodologies, technology, external regulation, and industry standard.

**Behavioural Competencies**  

* **Manages complexity.** Detail oriented, strong communication and negotiation skills, works well under pressure, prioritises effectively, and handles multiple inquiries concurrently. Makes sense of complex, high\-volume, sometimes contradictory information.
* **Ensures accountability.** Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments; tracks performance and helps the team learn from success, failure, and feedback.
* **Balances partners.** Anticipates and balances the needs of multiple collaborators across regions; maintains a professional attitude under pressure.
* **Collaborates.** Builds partnerships and works collaboratively to meet shared objectives; shares credit and invites candid views.
* **Instills trust.** Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* **Courage.** Steps up to address difficult issues; raises tough issues with leadership early.
* **Influences.** Uses compelling arguments to gain support and commitment; deftly explains impacts to internal teams.
* **Contributes to effective team behaviours.** Applies diverse skills to achieve common goals; leverages strengths and addresses weaknesses.

  

**Qualifications**  

**Essential**
  

* 2\+ years' experience as a project administrator or project coordinator in a technical or software implementation environment.
* Strong technical competence and ability to understand complex software systems.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to work upward to senior leadership and across a wide range of audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, globally distributed environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills; able to dive deep while keeping perspective on big\-picture goals.
* Ability to engage and coordinate teams within tight timeframes and manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Self\-directed, motivated, and able to multitask in a fast\-paced ad\-technology environment.
* Ability to work flexible hours to overlap with AU and UK or US time zones as needed.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Proficiency in ServiceNow, particularly Project Portfolio Management or Strategic Portfolio Management modules.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Teams in a global delivery context.
* Experience working with retail media, ad\-tech, or e\-commerce platforms.
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as the DPDP Act 2023 (India) and GDPR.

**Education**  

  

**Essential**
  

* An undergraduate degree in Project Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or equivalent industry experience.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Professional Project Management accreditation, Agile or PMI or similar, and/or demonstrated work experience as a project coordinator or administrator.
* ITIL Foundation certified.

  

**Additional Information**  

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  

  

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400\+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real\-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry\-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.  

  

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.  

* **People centricity:** We focus on employee well\-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* **Growth:** There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting\-edge solutions and forward\-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

  

These pillars and values are our foundation\-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.  

  

**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
  

Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.
